up: Identify all compounds (molecules) reported in the document with chembl_id 'CHEMBL5303711'. Return the following columns: molecule_chembl_id (the public ChEMBL ID for the compound), pref_name (preferred name of the compound), canonical_smiles (canonical SMILES string of the compound), and the document's chembl_id to confirm the source. Use an inner join from docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and left join to compound_structures on molregno to get the SMILES. Do not apply any filters on doc_type, confidence_score, target_type, or units. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, d.chembl_id AS document_chembl_id FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5303711'
